policy.primaryNoticeRule: 2026-07-21 primary notice is the baseline; the reviewed official Nepal 2026-07-30 supplementary image specifically extends registration to 2026-08-05 and permits expired passport details for initial online application. Do not infer any other modifications.
policy.supplementaryNoticeRule: Each reviewed supplement changes only the precise rules explicitly stated in its contents. Unreviewed titles never extend dates, authorize other fees, or alter other cohorts.

notices.titleNe: सन् २०२६ को प्रथम चरणको कोरियन भाषा परीक्षाको आवेदन फाराम दर्ता गर्ने सम्बन्धि सूचना ।
notices.titleEn: 2026 first-phase Korean-language examination application registration notice
notices.safeEffect: Baseline exact registration, eligibility, fee, upload and EPS-TOPIK rules are extracted into the Nepal exact-answer catalog.

notices.titleNe: भाषा परीक्षाको आवेदन दिनेहरुका लागि अत्यन्त जरुरी सूचना ।
notices.titleEn: Very urgent notice for language-test applicants
notices.safeEffect: Official July 26 notice warns applicants against multiple signups for one passport, changed email/repeated payment, repeated browser tabs and duplicate transactions. Maintain own contact details and saved login/application slip, verify entered data, and use the official query/correction procedure where applicable. The guide appendix has not been promoted as a live application flow; no deadline extension is claimed from this notice.

notices.titleNe: आवेदन प्रकृया हाललाई स्थगित गरिएको सम्बन्धमा ।
notices.titleEn: Notice that the application process was temporarily suspended
notices.safeEffect: Treat the online application process as having experienced a temporary suspension on 2026-07-28. Do not infer a deadline extension or other rule change.

notices.titleNe: अनलाईन दरखास्त प्रणाली पुन: सुचारु भएको सम्बन्धी सूचना ।
notices.titleEn: Notice that the online application system resumed
notices.safeEffect: Treat the online application system as having resumed after the temporary suspension. No deadline extension is claimed.

notices.titleNe: अनलाईन दरखास्त पेश गर्ने तथा राहदानी सम्बन्धमा ।
notices.titleEn: Notice regarding online application submission and passport
notices.safeEffect: Official EPS Nepal inline notice dated 2026-07-30 extends the first-phase online application end date through 2026-08-05. An applicant whose passport has expired may submit the online application using that passport's details, but must present a valid passport when later filing the Job Application Form after passing language and skill exams. This does not authorize new applications after the closed period.
